title: High Margin Push List
subtitle: Penetration rate for high-margin products and upsell targets
upsellTooltipInfo:
How the System Works:
Favorite Product Mapping — the system finds the high-margin products most commonly bought within the same business segment (e.g. Distribution). A product is considered valid once at least 20 similar customers have bought it.
Gap Analysis — the system matches those favorite products against each customer's own purchase history to find the products they haven't bought yet.

How to Read the Data:
Category Percentage (e.g. Scanner — 48.7%) means 48.7% of customers in the same business type have already bought this category, but the customer you're viewing hasn't.

Bottom line: "Customers in the same business type as you have widely bought this product, but you haven't tried it yet."
summaryProductCountInfo: Number of high-margin products tracked for penetration rate this period.
summaryAvgPenetrationInfo: Average share of active customers who already bought each high-margin product.
summaryTotalBuyersInfo: Number of active customers (not double-counted even if they bought more than 1 product) who bought at least 1 high-margin product this period, out of the TOTAL active customers — combined Existing Active + new customers. This card's denominator is DIFFERENT from the "Existing Active" card on the High Margin Transactions tab, which only counts existing (established) customers, not new ones — so that number is much smaller. To compare percentages apples-to-apples with that tab, use the "Existing Active Buyers" card on the right instead of this one.
summaryExistingBuyersInfo: Of the total high-margin buyers, those who already had transaction history BEFORE this period started (Existing Active) — this numerator is comparable to the "HM Buyers" card on the High Margin Transactions tab. The matching denominator for a percentage is also on that tab, the "Existing Active" card — NOT the "Total HM Buyers" card's denominator on the left (that one is bigger since it includes new customers too).
summaryNewBuyersInfo: Of the total high-margin buyers, those whose very first-ever transaction falls WITHIN this period (new customers, never bought anything before) — not counted as "Existing Active" anywhere, including not in the "Existing Active" card on the High Margin Transactions tab.
summaryUpsellTargetInfo: Number of customers who haven't bought one of the favorite high-margin categories in their business segment yet.

buyers.noBreakdown: No transactions in this period yet.
